user_request: Original synthetic 7-slide monochrome lab report for assay scientists. Clean white and black; restrained source footer; native editable chart and table; visible caveats. Compare three invented storage formulations at 4 C for 14 days with matched independent lots; pilot screen, not validated shelf life. Content-led scientific evidence plate, not a fixed role sequence. Preserve captions, denominator definitions, and all warnings.

questions.question: Who will use this deck, and what do they already know?

answered.purpose: Specified in the request; preserve it.
answered.evidence: Specified in the request; preserve it.

intake.policy: Ask only if the answer would materially change the deck. Do not repeat answered questions or request routine permission; otherwise proceed with these assumptions.

profile_policy: Local workflow defaults, not model performance guarantees; use an explicit profile for other models.

must_do: Keep methods, result, and interpretation visually distinguishable.
avoid: Do not crop or decorate evidence in ways that obscure interpretation.
Do not present a proxy metric as the final outcome without qualification.

story_guidance: Use only the chosen candidate's story hints. Derive slide order and evidence shapes from the argument, not a fixed template.

renderer.suggestion_policy: Grammar role_variants are style hints, not capabilities. renderer.role_variants is authoritative; choose any supported pair and optional layout variant that fits the content.

deck_style.style_preset: copy from the chosen route candidate
deck_style.composition_grammar: copy grammar_id from the same candidate

slide_common.title: assertion or governing question
sources: stable source IDs such as S1

authoring_rules: Choose one route candidate from the evidence and audience; keep its preset and grammar together. Use the fallback when uncertain and honor explicit style locks.
Story hints and any starter_sequence are optional suggestions; adapt to the evidence without copying another candidate's story.
Use only role/variant pairs in renderer.role_variants so v2 owns the geometry. Requested shapes outside that map need a supported representation or an explicit capability limitation.
Avoid more than two consecutive slides with the same concrete variant.
Shorten or split content before shrinking below the readability contract.
Do not invent evidence or citations; label synthetic illustrations. All profiles must pass the same finalizer QA and rendered review.
Before approval, compare critical values, units, denominators, caveats, and source IDs against the supplied evidence in both outline and rendered slides. Layout QA is not a factual audit.

commands.repair_loop: Read <qa-dir>/qa_report.json and contact sheet, edit outline.json, rerun affected checks until clean or report a blocker.
